title: Kelvin Lubona v The People (APPEAL NO. 244/2017) [2024] ZMSC 6 (14 May 2024)
outcome_detail: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence quashed; appellant now stands acquitted. The three key pieces of evidence relied on against the appellant did not meet admissibility requirements — two lacked corroboration and the arresting officer's evidence was wrongly admitted. The ballistic examination did not connect the firearm to the gunshot wounds; possession of the gun by the principal witness undermined his testimony, which required corroboration to implicate the appellant.
